decision.add_bridge_window_if: At both fully covered 10 ps and 15 ps checkpoints, after checking 3-CV-to-path mapping, the same local CV-space neighbor pair(s) still fail the existing 0.2 histogram-intersection gate and independent coverage does not improve under continued sampling. Rare correlated full-frame visits do not by themselves rule out a bridge; a projected-s gap alone does not justify one.
decision.continue_existing_windows_if: At 10 ps, the same fixed-CV analysis shows improved independent sample coverage or overlap for the currently weak local activation_full_007/008 pair (5 ps histogram intersection 0.0833), with distributions remaining consistent with their declared restraint centers. Reassess cumulatively at 15 ps; distinguish full-frame visits from post-equilibration and decorrelated support.
decision.current_read: Continue existing windows to the 10 ps checkpoint before deciding on bridges. The s=0.1125 bin has 21 full-frame visits, 3 post-equilibration frames before thinning, and zero decorrelated estimator samples. At s=0.6875, the apparent zero is numerical; stable accumulation gives nonzero mass and a sampled PMF of 20.6091 kcal/mol. Neither 1D bin alone establishes a need for a bridge.
decision.projection_ambiguity: Near s=0.1125, the 11 decorrelated samples in s=0.075..0.15 have alternative-segment ambiguity margins 0.0027..0.0499 A (median 0.0195 A). Check the underlying 3-CV mapping before any bridge decision; do not use a new ambiguity cutoff.
decision.promotion_limits: The 5 ps checkpoint fails histogram overlap and per-window effective-sample gates (N_k 3–49 vs minimum 100), has global unbiased ESS 12.66, and leaves orthogonal stationarity unresolved. A connected MBAR graph is not evidence of a converged PMF or validated barrier.
decision.treat_as_target_drift_if: Compare each window's biased-CV distributions with its declared centers across the recorded split blocks at 10 ps and 15 ps. Flag target drift when the shift exceeds the corresponding block-bootstrap 95% interval; retarget from observed CV-space distributions before deciding where a bridge belongs.

decorrelated_estimator_empty_bin.interpretation: No decorrelated estimator sample falls in this bin. The bin has 21/5700 full-frame visits and 3 samples after the existing equilibration discard but before thinning. It is sparse post-equilibration estimator support, not absent from the retained MD trajectory. Nearby projection ambiguity is reported separately; this 1D bin is not connectivity evidence.

stored_zero_but_sampled_bin.interpretation: Numerical cancellation in weighted histogram accumulation, not a raw support gap. The source projection implementation uses np.histogram(s, edges, weights=weights), which loses this small mass in the presence of much larger bins.

overlap_and_orthogonal_channels.all_frames_retained_without_owner_censor: All supplied frames; no proton-owner censoring

reproduction.method: Reloaded all 57 accepted immutable production receipts; reran recorded select_uncorrelated selection and common MBAR using the locked project environment; verified N_k exactly equals analysis.json; projected the resulting 749 samples on the exact recorded 3-CV path.
reproduction.stable_accumulation: Per-bin np.bincount over original projected samples and MBAR weights; compared with stored np.histogram result.

scope: Read-only audit of cumulative full_path_300K checkpoint_05ps; no bins, restraints, states, windows, inputs, or jobs changed.
